WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS hof_count
    FROM hall_of_fame h
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    WHERE h.inducted = 'Y'
    GROUP BY p.death_state
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT hof_count
    FROM state_counts
    WHERE hof_count > (SELECT AVG(hof_count) FROM state_counts)
)
SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(hof_count - (SELECT AVG(hof_count) FROM state_counts)) AS average_amount_above
FROM above_average
